study: DIR-SPRINT0: bounded three-family steering-direction discovery (D3 acoustic-prior contrast, D4 transcription-fidelity contrast, D5 phonetic-concept steering) against historical matched controls
authority: separately human-authorized development sprint; core v6, METHOD_CONTRACT and every historical verdict unchanged
scientific_question: Does any new direction family produce actual English first-token corrections, beyond matched D2 and random controls, with acceptable Mandarin, English and EOS safety, at the frozen L16 DG-02 site and realized chord e*?

population.selection_features: identity only (role, dialogue, UID hash, audio existence / mono 16 kHz); no correctness, language, reference, baseline prediction, phonetic score or gate value

calibration_bank.definition: ALL FULL300 documented-exposure utterances (unlabeled; D5 concept prototypes only)

environment.phone_provider_process: child CPU process of Job A (acl1 interpreter; same torch/transformers as the audited provider venv), torch threads 4, float32, no TF32

baseline.provider: cached.Branch + cached._processed + core_p1.processed_argmax; cached_greedy is replay-loop reference only
baseline.argmax_tie: lowest token ID; explicit argmax (not topk tie order)
baseline.tie_implementation_note: cached_greedy uses topk for its next ID; new canonical baseline uses the existing processed_argmax explicitly to preserve the R2/D2 lowest-ID tie convention, not topk tie order

queries.inventory: all t=0..T-1; t=T only if cached baseline terminated=eos
queries.prestep_cache: prompt + content[:t-1] for t>=1; feed content[t-1]
queries.pulse_structural_eligibility: t>=1 AND complete UTF8 prefix AND no unexpected special content token AND finite native site/raw logits
queries.t0: inventory/gate row retained; frozen forced-prefix no-edit exclusion
queries.EOS: real EOS prediction query eligible if other structural checks pass; EOS not a veto
queries.cap: no invented t=T EOS query after 200-token cap
queries.gate_provider_failure: g=0 with original reason; ungated arms unaffected
queries.invalid_direction: that arm exact no-edit at that query; every other arm unchanged

gate.conflict_logits: raw model logits BEFORE generation processors; float32 full-vocabulary log_softmax
gate.attention_source: original R2 full_replay(use_cache=False, attention=True) on canonical cached B0 content, query 4+t-1
gate.local_lid: native_lid; SOT-only; softmax over full 100 language-token vocabulary; actual PCM crop padded to30s
gate.null: recompute one all-zero 30s float32 waveform through same native provider; pin probabilities and waveform/model hashes
gate.cropped_lid_cache: within utterance, exact audio/model/preprocess/start/end hashes only

compatibility.cached_replay_equals_cached_baseline: bitwise raw logits/site, processed argmax, tokens/termination
compatibility.quantiles: numpy linear quantiles over all structurally eligible queries; no favorable subset
compatibility.causality_probe_queries: per utterance first eligible, median eligible, last eligible; deduplicate
compatibility.fail_action: INVALID and STOP; never replace full-replay gate with cached-attention gate
compatibility.site_relative_L2_definition: norm64(r_full-r_cached)/norm64(r_cached); same native site, zero norm invalid
compatibility.probe_attention_definition: L1 between heard-masked, renormalized ten-head mean cross-attention distributions at the same query

B0.role: canonical forced-ZH transcribe baseline; the only persistent history

E.role: D0 only; own cold cache fed the identical B0 content prefix

TL.role: D4 only; own cold cache fed the identical B0 content prefix; generation_config.task_to_id.translate=50359

NULL.audio: np.zeros(30*16000, float32) through the identical feature extractor/encoder (R2 null); one encoder output per job
NULL.role: D3 only; own cold cache per utterance fed the identical B0 content prefix

branches.identity: same absolute query index 4+t-1; fed tokens == prompt + content[:t]; separate DiagBranch objects/caches; site = L16 DG-02 r=q+u_source in native BF16; logits float32 of BF16

D0.name: prompt vector (historical P2-DIR D0)
D0.h_E: E-branch L16 DG-02 site at the query
D0.orientation: toward the forced-EN prompt state (historical P2-DIR D0 +)

D1.name: unique-language subspace (historical P2-DIR D1)
D1.assignment: original fold semantics: utterance of dialogue d receives fold d (fitted without dialogue d); assignment made in the CPU construct stage from population metadata, never by the GPU runner

D2.gradient: one native-BF16 scratch query with zero float32 probe, torch.autograd.grad(J, probe); no backward/weight update
D2.tangent: float64 g-h*dot(h,g)/dot(h,h); normalize with historical epsilon; serialize float32
D2.scratch_clean_identity: bitwise site/raw logits against ordinary cached query

VAC.name: v_AC local acoustic difference (historical SRC-CF0-P construction)

regions.end_rule: regular full windows plus unique right-anchored final full window; if N<16000 use [0,N)
regions.padding: native _features pads each raw crop to 30s; no energy normalization
regions.merge: maximal adjacent identical sample labels, no gap filling/minimum-span deletion

s1_regions.source: R0 run1 primary windows and track_heard_intervals only; no oracle/script/SVD groups
s1_regions.attention: fresh matched M cached-query attention; mean frozen heads then restrict real heard frames; require raw heard mass >=0.5; normalize heard mass in float64
s1_regions.association: each maximal EN interval clipped to heard horizon; discard <4000 samples; length=min(interval length,32000); candidate starts interval-left+n*320 plus unique right anchored last start; greatest normalized query-attention integral over fractional frame overlaps, then earliest start/end
s1_regions.absent: NO_EN_REGION / LOW_HEARD_MASS / LOW_ASSOCIATION / LOW_ENERGY; retain row, fallback M ranking

VAC.association_attention: cached B0 query frozen alignment-head attention (S1 'fresh matched M cached-query attention')
VAC.mask: lexical_compatibility.hard_mask: positive float32 zero on [a,b), outside bytes identical
VAC.features: lexical_compatibility.waveform_model_inputs; zero-change identity with batch_model_inputs required per utterance
VAC.masked_state: cold forced-ZH DiagBranch on the masked encoder output fed prompt + the identical B0 prefix; L16 DG-02 site
VAC.when_constructible: S1 target status OK and direction status OK; otherwise explicit no-edit with reason

D3.name: acoustic-prior contrast
D3.branches: B0 (original audio) and NULL (all-zero 30 s audio), identical forced-ZH prompt and B0 content prefix
D3.log_probs: float32 torch.log_softmax of processed logits (suppress_tokens -> -inf; t>=1 so no begin suppression), upcast to float64
D3.contrast: A(v) = l_B(v) - max(l_N(v), log(1e-12)); floor applied after the log-softmax

legal_static.definition: token IDs < 50257 (EOS), not in generation_config.suppress_tokens, not special, whose byte string is UTF-8-boundary legal (first byte not 0x80-0xBF; strict decode succeeds or fails only with 'unexpected end of data' at the end)

D3.legal_per_query: legal_static AND finite l_B AND finite l_N
D3.plausibility: l_B(v) >= max_w l_B(w) + log(1e-3) (max over the full processed vocabulary, EOS included)
D3.plausibility_justification: covers the actuator's first-order reach at e* (P2-DIR A = ||g_tan|| e* = 5.72 [5.18, 6.30] nats; log(1e-3) = -6.91); adapts to entropy, unlike S1's fixed Top-20 (which missed most English-confusion targets); not tuned on any D3 outcome
D3.candidate: c_AP = argmax over plausible legal set of S; exact ties -> lowest token ID

abstentions.baseline_is_candidate: c_AP == b_t -> exact no-edit (no gradient call)

D3.EOS: EOS can be b_t (EOS query) but never c_AP
D3.objective: J = z[c_AP] - z[b_t] on the scratch query's float32 raw logits (both unsuppressed)
D3.gradient: historical zero-probe scratch autograd (readout.ZeroProbe / clone_scratch / cache_fingerprint), one torch.autograd.grad, no parameter gradients
D3.comparator_D3CD: direct contrastive token selection: top-1 := c_AP where D3 status is 'candidate', else B0 top-1; non-steering, not energy-matched; never a pulse

D4.name: transcription-fidelity contrast
D4.entanglement: Whisper <|translate|> means X->English: TR-TL partly encodes 'do not output English'; reported, not resolved by sign choice

D5.name: phonetic-concept steering
D5.exclusion_reason: voicing and aspiration follow espeak's English/Mandarin label conventions (English p/t/k never aspirated; Mandarin b/d/g written p/t/k), so they partly encode language; no language-neutral representation can be established without outcomes; kept descriptive
D5.tone: provider tone mass recorded descriptively; never converted into a concept
D5.posteriors: PhoneProvider.posteriors once on the full original 16 kHz waveform (CPU float32, 4 threads); never on crops
D5.provider_apparatus: at Job A start each child reruns the public engineering clips sample1.flac and aishell_example_mandarin.wav: in-job repeat bitwise AND (bitwise equal to the sealed engineering hash OR max |dlogp| <= 1e-3 with argmax agreement 1.0)
D5.provider_failure_scope: apparatus failure or a child that does not finish its loop blocks D5 family-wide; a single utterance's provider failure only abstains that utterance's evidence (provider_failure); prototype coverage minima still apply
D5.window: R2 max_attention_window of the query (full-replay frozen ten-head attention; the gate's own window), [start_sample, end_sample)
D5.weights: phone_provider.interval_weights: fraction of each 400-sample provider span inside the window
D5.evidence: q_k = sum_j w_j e_j sum_v p_jv C_vk / sum_j w_j e_j s_j over segmental v (fraction of emitting phone mass in concept class k)

validity.silence: silent windows have no emitting frame (engineering: synthetic silence/noise frames s_j <= 0.13) -> low_emitting_weight
validity.language_convention: handled by excluding voicing/aspiration from the primary concepts; Mandarin-convention mass reported descriptively, never a gate

D5.threshold_justification: engineering (public clips + synthetic only): per-frame segmental mass bimodal (speech emitting frames >= 0.98, 2.7-5.1% of frames in (0.2,0.8)); silence/noise frames <= 0.13; 1-s speech windows emitting weight p05 2.6-8.2 (min 0 in a pause), silence 0; 1-s windows hold 50-51 provider frames, 20 = 0.4 s

bank.queries: structural queries of the canonical cached B0 (same generator) with valid D5 evidence
bank.state: B0 L16 DG-02 site, unit-normalized h/||h|| (float64)
bank.quantile_method: numpy linear over all valid bank queries (pooled)
bank.dialogue_balancing: Delta_d = mean_High,d - mean_Low,d for dialogues with >= 5 High and >= 5 Low; v_k = normalize(mean_d Delta_d) (equal dialogue weight)
bank.mu: dialogue-macro mean of q_k over valid bank queries

D5.direction: z_k = (q_k - mu_k)/sd_k; d_PHON = readout.tangent_unit(sum_k z_k v_k, h_B); ||z|| < 1e-6 -> abstain
D5.orientation: toward bank states rich in the concept classes the local audio over-expresses

shuffle.pool: D5-valid structural queries of the same utterance
shuffle.rule: order by (SHA256(tag|seed|UID|t), t); position i receives the z-vector of position (i+1) mod n
shuffle.construction: identical prototypes, normalization, tangent rule and e*; recipient's own h_B
shuffle.singleton: n == 1: donor = self, flagged uninformative, still pulsed
shuffle.degenerate_reporting: count bitwise-identical donor/recipient z vectors and cos(d_D5, d_D5SH) > 0.9

D5.not_whisper_only: requires the external pretrained phone model, the frozen feature/concept tables and the FULL300 calibration bank

dose.unreachable_or_out_of_tolerance: explicit exact no-edit; retain planned dose and denominator; no rescaling/floor
dose.consumed_vs_proposed_error_definition: abs(consumed_chord_norm/proposed_chord_norm-1); norm ratio, NOT vector relative L2
dose.native_consumption_preview: record pristine native q,u,r=q+u; preview q+(u+(proposed_r-r)) on same native site device/dtype/order; never inspect FFN/logits
dose.preview_guard_failure: native_consumption_unattainable: exact no-edit with planned dose retained; no coefficient refinement, gate floor or alternative energy
dose.solver_calls_per_arm: one original solve_scale, max8 emulations; pulse_action may use hash-verified cached solver result, never solve a second time
dose.actual_consumption_preview_check: bitwise predicted/actual FFN input for edited cells; otherwise INVALID; exact no-edit output=B0 for abstentions
dose.per_arm_target: ungated e*; gated e*·g_old solved as its own native chord (never coefficient × gate); zero gate -> exact zero
dose.matched_fraction_denominator: cells with a valid direction and a nonzero target
dose.new_family_energy_failure: that variant ineligible for promising status

job_A_gate.compatibility: ALL frozen SRD2-G0 compatibility predicates pass

evaluation.alignment: post-seal normalize/segment_units, align_tokens and R2 unit_to_token_positions; no timings needed
evaluation.English_targets: historical p2r_population.target_set with raw/lower/capitalized/UPPER and optional leading space, exact prefix-ID stability, distinguishing prefix >=min(2,len(word))
evaluation.Mandarin_targets: historical correct-state singleton baseline first-token ID
evaluation.collisions: different strata or multiple English reference units at one query -> primary unalignable; Mandarin same-category deduplicated to unique query
evaluation.primary_confusions: wrong-language substitution or script/transliteration; exclude deletions/same-language substitutions into separate descriptive ledgers
evaluation.correction: B0 argmax notin Y and arm argmax in Y
evaluation.corruption: B0 argmax in Y and arm argmax notin Y
evaluation.structural_fallbacks: count as no-edit, stay in mapped stratum denominator
evaluation.ambiguous_offsets_or_targets: explicit unalignable ledger; never repair using oracle timings
evaluation.EOS_deletions: secondary only; no missing-word recovery claim
evaluation.utility: U_a = C_a - H_ZH_a - H_EN_a (equal predeclared event costs)
evaluation.full_population_reporting: all 240 utterances / all inventory rows; mapping, structural, constructible, edited and common-eligible denominators separately
evaluation.EOS_severe: arm top-1 == EOS, B0 top-1 != EOS, baseline remaining content tokens (T - t) >= 10; over all inventory queries; reference-free single-query early-stop risk proxy
evaluation.gap: G = max_{k notin Y} zp_k - max_{k in Y} zp_k on processed (suppressed) float32 logits; Delta_a = G_B0 - G_a
evaluation.script_mass: raw float32 full-vocabulary P_E / P_M (tokenizer partition), descriptive
evaluation.D3CD_top1: c_AP where D3 status == candidate else B0 top-1

constructible.D3: D3 status in {candidate, baseline_is_candidate} AND (baseline_is_candidate OR gradient direction ok)

coverage.EN_confusion_denominator: mapped EN-confusion queries that are structurally eligible

safety.damage_dialogue: no dialogue with >= 3 ZH corruptions AND active ZH corruption rate > 0.20

mechanistic.definition: dialogue-macro mean over mapped structural EN-confusion queries of (Delta_v - Delta_RND(matched))

statistics.cluster: paired resample of 20 sorted dialogues with replacement; same draws for every arm
statistics.primary_family_members: for v in {D3, D3G, D4, D4G, D5, D5G} (24) + D5/D5G vs shuffle C and U (4) + D3/D3G utility vs D3CD (2) = 30
statistics.multiplicity_disclosure: 6 candidate variants (3 families x 2 controller variants); either variant may qualify its family

definitions.PROVIDER_OR_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCKED: family-wide construction failure: D3 null branch finite < 0.99 of structural queries or legal-set hash mismatch; D4 prompt/task identity failure; D5 provider apparatus failure, table/concept digest mismatch, bank capture incomplete or any prototype failure
definitions.INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE: constructible fraction < 0.5 on structural or on structural mapped EN-confusion queries; or (outcome) a variant with energy+power+advantage lacks safety-estimable edits
definitions.PROMISING_FEASIBILITY: some variant passes energy, power, advantage, safety-estimability and safety
definitions.SAFETY_FAILED: some variant passes energy, power, advantage and safety-estimability but none passes safety
definitions.LEXICAL_POWER_INSUFFICIENT: no variant passes energy + power + advantage

terminal_definitions.DIR_SPRINT0_INVALID: critical experiment-wide failure (provenance, firewall, B0/cache/site identity, restore, solver/hook/FFN integrity, incomplete matrix, old30 apparatus, weights, D2 or RND ungated energy validity, failed audit), or all three new families PROVIDER_OR_CONSTRUCTION_BLOCKED
terminal_definitions.DIR_SPRINT0_COMPUTE_BLOCKED: post-A Job B recost > 9000 s (STOP before Job B for a human resource decision)
terminal_definitions.DIR_SPRINT0_OPPORTUNITY_INSUFFICIENT: Job A coverage or evaluator opportunity predicates fail, or no new family is VALID_AND_TESTED
terminal_definitions.DIR_SPRINT0_MECHANISTIC_EFFECT_ONLY: no family with power+advantage; >= 1 VALID family variant with a mechanistic effect (gap closed beyond matched random >= 0.5 nat, adjusted lower > 0)

stage_aware_rule_evaluation: before Job B apply only available integrity/resource/Job-A predicates; pending energy/evaluation/audit predicates are NOT evaluated as failures. At final evaluation every rule input must be present; missing critical evidence =>INVALID.

metrics_conventions.rates: corruptions/unique mapped queries; active rate uses actually nonzero achieved edits, not g>0
metrics_conventions.lost_energy: sum(target_norm^2 on no-edit unreachable/invalid requests)/sum(planned_target_norm^2), not counts
metrics_conventions.uninformative_query_fraction: D5 shuffle: queries in singleton utterances / D5-valid queries
metrics_conventions.beyond_heard_scope: duration > 30 s rows primary-unalignable; still executed and in all-240 coverage
metrics_conventions.count_predicates: integer events; rates computed full precision, no rounded table thresholding
metrics_conventions.numeric_missing: undefined is never a passing comparison; integrity metrics missing =>INVALID; lexical opportunity/ratio missing=>INCONCLUSIVE
metrics_conventions.critical_failure_flag: any required completed integrity/audit failure; a failed FULL audit sets this flag true. Pending conditional phases are not treated as failed matrices.
metrics_conventions.correction_dialogue_share: max per-dialogue corrections / total corrections; zero total -> undefined

firewall.construct_stage_metadata: dialogue_id from the frozen population only for D1 fold assignment, D5 bank dialogue balancing and cluster bookkeeping; never a lexical label

compute.job_B_observed_component: sum over structural queries of [2*c + n_autograd_q*0.0434598979 + n_pulse_q*(0.0177027043 + 0.02 + 104768/v)] + max(800, l + 240*a + w + 180)
compute.post_A_recost: both forecasts <= 9000 s, from the reference-free complete planned pulse matrix
compute.timeout: preserved as INVALID; no third job, no subset

outputs.logit_storage: lossless native BF16 bits full vocabulary per query/arm
outputs.seals: commit/push immutable manifests and complete content-addressed artifact hashes

historical_apparatus.pulse_numerics: unchanged original P2-DIR guards; no relaxed reproduction tolerance
